rules.message: NCORES outside the supported CLINT register range

rules.when: power2(COHERENCE_BANKS) and (NCORES == 1 or COHERENCE_BANKS == 1 or PRIVATE_DCACHE)
rules.message: Coherence banks require private MSI and a power-of-two count

rules.when: NCORES == 1 or not (PRIVATE_ICACHE or CACHE_TO_CACHE or CACHE_BURSTS or MESI or LOCAL_DCACHE_READS or LOCAL_DCACHE_WRITES) or PRIVATE_DCACHE
rules.message: Private I-cache/local paths require private MSI data caches
Select private MSI data caches or the shared cache, not both

rules.when: not SHARED_CACHE or power2(SHARED_CACHE_WORDS) and SHARED_CACHE_WORDS >= 2
not (NCORES > 1 and PRIVATE_DCACHE) or power2(PRIVATE_DCACHE_WORDS) and power2(PRIVATE_DCACHE_LINE_WORDS) and PRIVATE_DCACHE_WORDS >= 2 * COHERENCE_BANKS * PRIVATE_DCACHE_LINE_WORDS
rules.message: Each coherence bank needs power-of-two private DCACHE capacity and at least two complete lines

rules.when: not (NCORES > 1 and PRIVATE_DCACHE) or power2(PRIVATE_ICACHE_WORDS) and power2(PRIVATE_ICACHE_LINE_WORDS) and PRIVATE_ICACHE_WORDS >= 2 * COHERENCE_BANKS * PRIVATE_ICACHE_LINE_WORDS
rules.message: Each coherence bank needs power-of-two private ICACHE capacity and at least two complete lines

rules.when: (NCORES == 1 and not SHARED_CACHE) or (P.BUS_SUPPORTED and not P.DTIM_SUPPORTED and not P.IROM_SUPPORTED and not P.DCACHE_SUPPORTED and not P.ICACHE_SUPPORTED and not P.BURST_EN)
rules.message: Multicore requires a shared bus with no private memories/caches or bursts

rules.when: not (NCORES > 1 and PRIVATE_DCACHE) or not (P.ZICBOM_SUPPORTED or P.ZICBOZ_SUPPORTED or P.ZICBOP_SUPPORTED)
rules.message: MSI baseline does not implement cache-maintenance operations

rules.when: not (NCORES > 1 and PRIVATE_DCACHE or SHARED_CACHE) or not P.SVADU_SUPPORTED
rules.message: Cached SMP uses software PTE A/D updates (Svade)

rules.when: not (NCORES > 1 and PRIVATE_DCACHE or SHARED_CACHE) or not P.SVPBMT_SUPPORTED
rules.message: Multicore caches use physical RAM attributes; Svpbmt must be disabled

rules.when: (NCORES == 1 and not SHARED_CACHE) or P.AHBW == P.XLEN
